Christopher J. Yates was born and raised in Kent and studied law at Oxford University before working as a puzzle editor in London. He now lives in New York's Hudson Valley. His second dark academia novel, 'The Rabbit Club' will be released July 8, 2025. It is a return to the Oxford world he created in his debut, 'Black Chalk' and contains three overlapping characters and multiple Easter eggs for fans of that novel.
